description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance (Chapter) 40 Call Out with effect from 22.11.2022 all the members of the Armed Forces
categorisation: This gazette content involves the invocation of powers under the Public Security Ordinance (a legal framework) to call out armed forces for maintaining public order. It constitutes a legal/regulatory action through a statutory instrument (Order) issued under existing legislation, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, structural, or other specialized category.
